# OpenArmX MuJoCo

> Experimental OpenArmX dual-arm robotics workspace: MuJoCo simulation, inverse kinematics, impedance control, cooperative manipulation, and acados-based nonlinear model predictive cooperative control (NMPCC). Documentation is available in English and Chinese.

Repository: https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco
Documented branch: 6.0_basic
Upstream fork source: https://github.com/openarmx/openarmx_mujoco

This is a factual project index. The repository contains simulation and numerical research scripts, not a validated hardware deployment package. The basic IK demo and the acados-based experiments have different dependencies. Historical outputs mentioned in research notes are not all included in the repository.

## Start here

- [README and quick start](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/README.md): Setup, model check, interactive demo, experiment map and limitations.
- [Dual-arm inverse kinematics](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/ik.py): Position-driven interactive IK; `python ik.py --check` builds and loads the model without opening a viewer.
- [URDF and visual mesh conversion](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/view_ros2_visual_meshes.py): Converts the included ROS2-exported model and meshes for MuJoCo.
- [Source robot URDF](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/openarmx_robot.urdf): Robot description used by the conversion script.

## Control and contact experiments

- [Force-control experiment](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/ikforce.py): Torque/force-control experiment with model-check and headless modes.
- [Impedance experiment](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/ikforce_impedance.py): Impedance-control scene and logic.
- [Box-clamping demo](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/grasp_box_demo.py): Position-driven contact experiment using arm-end pads.

## NMPCC research

- [Two-link numerical experiment guide](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/EXPERIMENT2_GUIDE.md): Research context, documented implementation differences, author-machine commands and unfinished work.
- [NMPCC implementation](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/nmpcc.py): CasADi/acados implementation including the two-link plant.
- [Two-link environment-force experiment](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/exp_sim2_nmpcc.py): Numerical experiment separate from the OpenArmX contact scenes.
- [OpenArmX cooperative controller](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/nmpcc_cart.py): Cooperative controller with joint-space states and Cartesian task terms.
- [OpenArmX manipulation experiment](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/exp2_nmpcc_latest.py): Box manipulation and configurable experimental runs.
- [Diagnostics](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/blob/6.0_basic/exp2_diagnostics.py): Checks used by the manipulation experiments.
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/Marco0431/openarmx_mujoco/issues): Bug reports and questions.
